other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered woman construction worker under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year
The child must be under 3 years of age
Assistance is available for the first two children only
Application can be submitted within 6 months of delivery and every year up to 3 years after delivery
A child living affidavit must be submitted for the second and third year of assistance
Registration must be renewed every three years, with a one‑year grace period after expiry
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per child, paid at ₹500 per month for up to three years after delivery.
